mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.25% (t-test of mean return vs 0 fails at p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0% (t-test of mean return vs 0 fails at p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in monthly job growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition (t-test of mean return vs 0 fails at p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 235.0) signals the Federal Reserve's likelihood of monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235.0 (t-test of mean return vs 0 fails at p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1150.0 (thousands of units) indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 45% of periods when HOUST > 1150.0 (t-test of mean return vs 0 fails at p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 105.0 (index 2017=100) indicates contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate production and profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 (t-test of mean return vs 0 fails at p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) growth rates below 0.0% signal a weakening housing market, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth rate < 0.0% and RSAFS growth rate < 0.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods meeting the trigger condition (t-test of mean return vs 0 fails at p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.05% (FEDFUNDS change > 0.05%) indicates active monetary tightening, raising borrowing costs and reducing corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS change > 0.05% (t-test of mean return vs 0 fails at p<0.05).
